reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: iMatrix rejected the API key for {org}. Enter a new key for the same organization.

data_description.api_key: The key starts with imx_ and is shown once when you create it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure iMatrix
reconfigure.description: Change the API key or API URL. The key must belong to the same organization.

data_description.api_key: The key starts with imx_ and is shown once when you create it.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless iMatrix support gave you a different address.

api_key.title: Connect to iMatrix
api_key.description: Create an API key in the iMatrix web app under Account Settings, Security, API keys, using the Home Assistant (read-only) preset. The key sees only the devices in groups granted to your user.

data_description.api_key: The key starts with imx_ and is shown once when you create it.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless iMatrix support gave you a different address.

user.title: Connect to iMatrix
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant signs in to iMatrix.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in to iMatrix again
reauth_oauth.description: The iMatrix sign-in for {org} expired or was revoked. Sign in again with an account in the same organization.

error.insufficient_permissions: The API key cannot read devices or sensor data. Create a key with the Home Assistant (read-only) preset.
error.unsupported_api: The iMatrix server returned an API version this integration does not support. Update the integration.

abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different iMatrix organization.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out generating the iMatrix sign-in link.
abort.missing_configuration: The iMatrix sign-in is not configured.
abort.no_url_available: No Home Assistant URL is available for the sign-in redirect.
abort.oauth_failed: Getting a token from iMatrix failed.
abort.oauth_timeout: Getting a token from iMatrix timed out.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The iMatrix sign-in is not available right now.
abort.insufficient_permissions: The signed-in user cannot read devices or sensor data.
abort.unsupported_api: The iMatrix server returned an API version this integration does not support.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the iMatrix cloud.

update_failed.message: Could not get data from the iMatrix cloud.

rate_limited.message: The iMatrix cloud rate limit was reached. Polling slows down until it recovers.

device_not_found.message: The device is not an iMatrix device.

entry_not_loaded.message: The iMatrix integration for this device is not loaded.

entity_not_channel.message: {entity_id} is not an iMatrix sensor channel.

api_error.message: The iMatrix cloud could not answer the request.

data_description.group_ids: Import only devices in these iMatrix groups and their subgroups. Leave empty for all devices.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask the iMatrix cloud for new readings, in seconds.
data_description.include_unmapped: Also create entities for channels iMatrix has no unit or meaning for. They start disabled.

get_faults.name: Get fault codes
get_faults.description: Returns active and recently reported fault codes and the dashboard lamps of a vehicle, from the last 7 days.

get_trips.name: Get trips
get_trips.description: Returns the trips of a vehicle, newest first. At most 31 days.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period. Defaults to 7 days ago (24 hours for history).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period. Defaults to now.

get_history.name: Get hourly history
get_history.description: Returns hourly mean, minimum, maximum and last values of an iMatrix sensor from the iMatrix cloud. At most 7 days.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period. Defaults to 7 days ago (24 hours for history).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period. Defaults to now.

api_key_expiring.title: iMatrix API key expires soon
api_key_expiring.description: The API key for {title} expires on {date}. Create a new key in the iMatrix web app and enter it with Reconfigure on the iMatrix integration.

rate_limited.title: iMatrix rate limit reached
rate_limited.description: {title} has been rate limited by the iMatrix cloud for more than 30 minutes. Raise the polling interval in the integration options, or select fewer groups.

no_devices.title: iMatrix API key sees no devices
no_devices.description: The API key for {title} cannot see any devices. An iMatrix API key sees only the devices in groups granted to the key's user, even when the user is an organization administrator. Grant the user access to the groups in iMatrix, then check the groups selected in the integration options.
